definitions.explanation: An event or circumstance that serves as the starting point for something new.

examples.english: Taking this opportunity; with this as a starting point.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{契機|けいき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}した→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧。
examples.english: I reconsidered my lifestyle, triggered by the illness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{契機|けいき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{転職|てんしょく}した→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧。
examples.english: I changed jobs, taking the occasion of my marriage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{契機|けいき}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}に→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}した→改善：00144_kaizen⟧。
examples.english: Taking this failure as an opportunity, the company significantly improved its quality control system.

notes:
{契機|けいき} marks a turning point or catalyst.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{契機|けいき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (taking ~ as an opportunity)
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{契機|けいき}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧ (with ~ as a catalyst)
- 〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{契機|けいき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧ (~ became the trigger)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {契機|けいき}: catalyst, trigger (formal)
- ⟦きっかけ→きっかけ：10309_kikkake⟧: opportunity, trigger (conversational)
- ⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧: opportunity, chance

NOTE: {契機|けいき} is more formal than ⟦きっかけ→きっかけ：10309_kikkake⟧ and often used in written language.
